tool_analysis:
1) Step Analysis: The recorded session logs into Magento admin, navigates to the Manage Products grid, explores mass-action controls, and confirms that numeric indexes for the Actions dropdown and Submit button are unreliable or absent. It successfully identifies stable semantics: selection links (Select All/Visible, etc.), per-row checkboxes, the Actions dropdown with options (Delete, Change status, Update Attributes), an associated Status select (Enabled/Disabled) for Change status, and a Submit button. Prior attempts failed due to over-reliance on numeric indexes and non-unique selectors for the mass-action dropdown, leading to agent step failures.

2) Task Definition: The tool should execute one chosen bulk mass-action on the current page of the Manage Products grid in Magento 1 admin. Supported actions: Delete, Change status (Enabled/Disabled), Update Attributes (navigate to mass attribute-edit form). It must first select products (via per-row checkboxes or selection links), then choose the requested mass-action, set any required parameters (status), and click Submit. Authentication to admin and navigation to the grid must also be handled.

3) Action Plan:
- Step A: Navigate directly to the Manage Products grid URL; if redirected to login, log in with provided admin credentials.
- Step B: Ensure we are on the Manage Products grid and the mass-action bar is visible; clear filters if requested.
- Step C: Select target products using either per-row checkboxes (by row index) or selection links (Select Visible / Select All) depending on inputs.
- Step D: Use the Actions dropdown in the mass-action bar to choose the requested bulk action (Delete / Change status / Update Attributes) by visible text. This control has no reliable numeric index, so it must be targeted semantically; an agentic step is appropriate here.
- Step E: If the action is Change status, select the desired status value (Enabled or Disabled) in the Status select adjacent to the Actions dropdown, again using semantic targeting.
- Step F: Click the Submit button in the mass-action bar to execute the action. This also requires semantic targeting (button text "Submit" near Actions).
- Step G (for Update Attributes): After submit, we land on the mass attribute-edit form; optionally stop there (demonstration of navigation) or just confirm arrival via content extraction.
- Step H: Optionally extract a brief summary of the operation outcome (e.g., success message, errors) for the caller.

4) Variable Identification:
- action_type (string enum: delete, status, attributes) – which mass action to execute.
- status_value (string enum: enabled, disabled) – only required when action_type = status.
- selection_mode (string enum: select_visible, select_all, by_rows) – how to choose target products.
- row_indexes (string) – comma-separated 1-based grid row indices to select when selection_mode = by_rows.
- clear_filters_first (bool) – whether to click Reset Filter before selecting, default false.
- confirm_delete (bool) – whether to confirm any delete confirmation dialog (if implemented), default true.

These parameters map directly to UI concepts: mass-action Actions select, Status select, selection links, per-row checkboxes, and Reset Filter.

5) Step Optimization & Determinism:
- Use direct navigation to the Manage Products grid instead of menu clicks.
- Login uses deterministic input steps with element hashes captured on the login page (username, password, login button). We will use those hashes in cssSelector form where stable, but primarily rely on elementHash only as metadata because the automation framework here cares about cssSelector/xpath. However, the logs did not expose CSS attributes, only element_hash and positional indexes; therefore, numeric indexes are unstable and should not be encoded. Instead, we will:
  * For login fields, rely on the element_hash values captured (3597a5c5e6 for username, 1c47a5217e for password, 6831836d17 for login button) via click/input-type steps.
  * For grid selection links and mass-action bar, use an agentic step that finds links/buttons/selects by their visible text labels and context (e.g., within mass-action bar above the grid). Previous errors showed that deterministic index-based select_change on index 137 failed; thus, we replace those with a single agent step to operate that bar given parameters.
- We avoid adding optional filtering/sorting operations since the core task is mass actions. However, we include clear_filters_first as a simple optional pre-action using Reset Filter.
- The most error-prone part (mass-action dropdown, Status select, Submit button) is consolidated into a single agentic step that:
  * Locates the mass-action bar by presence of links Select All/Select Visible and text "items selected".
  * Chooses the correct Actions option by visible text corresponding to {action_type}.
  * For status actions, chooses the proper status by text from {status_value}.
  * Clicks Submit.

This should fix prior failures where deterministic select_change could not resolve a unique element.

Because we cannot derive stable CSS selectors for the mass-action controls from the logs (no id/name attributes exposed) and numeric indexes were unreliable, those interactions must be handled agentically.

The tool therefore has:
- Deterministic steps for navigation, login, and optional Reset Filter.
- Agent steps for: (a) selecting rows according to selection_mode and row_indexes if necessary; (b) performing the chosen mass action via Actions dropdown, status select, and Submit button; and (c) optionally extracting post-action messages.

The tool purpose is single: execute one bulk mass action on the Manage Products grid with configurable selection and, for status changes, desired target status.
name: tool_bulk_product_massactions_v3
description: Perform Magento admin bulk product operations (Change status, Delete, Update Attributes) from the Manage Products grid using robust semantic selectors and agentic interaction for dynamic mass-action dropdowns.

steps.description: Navigate directly to the Magento Admin Manage Products grid URL. This may redirect to the login page if not authenticated.
Handle authentication if required, using semantic identification of the login form controls.
steps.task: If a Magento Admin login form is present, log in using username 'admin' and password 'password123' by locating the username and password fields and the login button based on their labels ('User Name', 'Password', 'Log in to Admin Panel'). Then ensure navigation completes to the Manage Products grid at Catalog → Manage Products.

steps.description: Optionally reset filters to start from an unfiltered grid when clear_filters_first is requested.
steps.task: On the Manage Products grid, if {clear_filters_first} is true, locate and click the 'Reset Filter' control in the grid toolbar to clear any existing filters, then wait for the grid to reload.

steps.description: Establish the target product selection set for the mass action using selection links or per-row checkboxes.
steps.task: On the Manage Products grid, select products according to {selection_mode}. If selection_mode is 'select_visible', click the 'Select Visible' link in the mass-action bar. If 'select_all', click 'Select All'. If 'by_rows', identify the products grid table and click the checkbox in the first column for each row whose 1-based index is listed in {row_indexes}. Confirm that at least one row is selected by checking the '{N} items selected' counter.

steps.description: Execute the requested mass action using the Actions dropdown, optional Status selector, and Submit button, handling delete confirmation when appropriate.
steps.task: In the mass-action bar above the products grid, operate the 'Actions' dropdown and any dependent controls according to {action_type} and {status_value}. Specifically: (1) Locate the select element labeled 'Actions' near the 'items selected' counter and selection links; (2) choose the option labeled 'Delete' if {action_type}='delete', 'Change status' if 'status', or 'Update Attributes' if 'attributes'; (3) if {action_type}='status', locate the 'Status' select within the same bar and choose 'Enabled' if {status_value}='enabled' or 'Disabled' if 'disabled'; (4) locate the 'Submit' button within the mass-action bar and click it to execute the action. If a confirmation dialog appears (likely for Delete), confirm it when {confirm_delete} is true, otherwise cancel.

steps.description: Capture a brief summary of the outcome of the mass action for the caller (success, error, or navigation to Update Attributes form).
steps.task: After submitting the mass action, observe the resulting page. If a success or error message appears in the Magento admin notification area (e.g., 'Total of X record(s) were updated', 'Total of X record(s) were deleted'), extract the message text. For 'attributes' action, simply verify that a mass attribute update page opened by checking for an 'Update Attributes' header.

input_schema.name: action_type
input_schema.description: Mass action to perform on selected products: 'delete' for Delete, 'status' for Change status, 'attributes' for Update Attributes.

input_schema.name: status_value
input_schema.description: Target status when action_type='status'. Must be 'enabled' or 'disabled'. Ignored for other actions.

input_schema.name: selection_mode
input_schema.description: How to select products in the grid: 'select_visible' uses the 'Select Visible' link; 'select_all' uses 'Select All'; 'by_rows' selects individual rows by their 1-based row indexes.

input_schema.name: row_indexes
input_schema.description: Comma-separated list of 1-based row indexes to select when selection_mode='by_rows' (e.g., '1,2,5'). Ignored for other modes.

input_schema.name: clear_filters_first
input_schema.description: If true, click 'Reset Filter' on the product grid before selecting products to ensure an unfiltered grid. Default false if omitted.

input_schema.name: confirm_delete
input_schema.description: For action_type='delete': whether to confirm the delete confirmation dialog if it appears. Default true if omitted.
